art_direction.scene: A fictional adult pauses on a nearly vertical low wall using two generous rounded jug holds, arms comfortably extended rather than locked. Both feet carry the body on broad footholds just above the mat, hips close to the wall and knees softly bent. The chest is quiet and the face unhurried, with no hanging or pull-up action. Leave an obvious oversized descent hold beside the feet and keep the wall section uncluttered. Use quilted textile illustration with stitched fabric shapes, readable adult anatomy, felt-like mat surfaces, and a calm blue and sand palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
